tools.name: polymarket_all_markets
tools.description: Paid data plan required. Return every active Polymarket market across all categories, not only crypto. AI execution credits do not unlock this export. The text result is one LLM-readable line per market: MARKET_NAME | OUTCOME PRICES | DEADLINE | MARKET_ID. The sweep fails closed if complete paginati

tools.name: polymarket_search_markets
tools.description: List Polymarket up/down crypto prediction markets for a coin. Returns market id, slug, window, status and timing. Use the returned id/slug with polymarket_get_market or polymarket_get_snapshots.

tools.name: polymarket_get_market
tools.description: Fetch a single Polymarket market by id (market_id) or by slug. Provide exactly one of market_id or slug.

tools.name: polymarket_get_snapshots
tools.description: Historical order-book snapshots (time series) for one Polymarket market. Use interval to downsample and include_orderbook for the full ladder. History depth is gated by plan.

tools.name: kalshi_search_markets
tools.description: List Kalshi crypto markets (full yes/no depth, DepthFeed-exclusive). Every account plan; the keyless demo surface returns a 402 upsell.

tools.name: kalshi_get_orderbook
tools.description: Latest yes/no order-book depth for a Kalshi market by ticker. Every account plan; only the keyless demo surface is refused.

tools.name: kalshi_get_snapshots
tools.description: Historical yes/no depth snapshots for a Kalshi market by ticker. Every account plan; history is bounded by your plan window.

tools.name: kalshi_get_candles
tools.description: Hourly OHLC candles (yes bid, yes ask, traded price) plus volume and open interest for a Kalshi market. This is the only history that exists for non-crypto Kalshi markets — Kalshi serves no historical order book — and it reaches back up to a year, far past the order-book capture. `price` is null in

tools.name: limitless_search_markets
tools.description: List currently-open Limitless (Base CLOB) markets, DepthFeed-exclusive. Every account plan; only the keyless demo surface is refused.

tools.name: limitless_get_orderbook
tools.description: Latest L2 depth (bids desc / asks asc) for a Limitless market by slug. Every account plan; only the keyless demo surface is refused.

tools.name: limitless_get_snapshots
tools.description: Historical L2 depth snapshots (time series) for a Limitless market by slug. Every account plan; history is bounded by your plan window.

tools.name: bars
tools.description: OHLCV price bars for US equities and ETFs, Binance spot pairs, and perpetual futures. One minute is the finest resolution; 5Min, 15Min, 1Hour and 1Day are rolled up from it and say so with `derived`. Spell a crypto pair the way the venue does (BTCUSDT, not BTC) and a perpetual with a .P suffix (BTCU

tools.name: backtest_paths
tools.description: Mid-price path per Polymarket market for backtesting, resampled to a fixed interval and bounded to each market's own lifetime so post-settlement books cannot leak in as risk-free fills. Returns {interval_seconds, markets:{<market_id>:{points:[[ts_ms, price_up, coin_price], …]}}} — up to 1000 points

tools.name: screener
tools.description: Cross-venue top-of-book snapshot for all assets across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Binance — a one-shot overview of the current state. No arguments.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the current session's plan, rate limits, history window, and coin access (reflects keyless demo vs. your API key).

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "bars" is 772 chars, far longer than this server's median (135). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "backtest_paths" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "kalshi_search_markets" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List Kalshi crypto markets (full yes/no depth, DepthFeed-exclusive). Requires a paid plan; keyless/Free returns a 402 upsell." → after: "List Kalshi crypto markets (full yes/no depth, DepthFeed-exclusive). Every account plan; the keyless demo surface returns a 402 upsell."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
